test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one which follows the same logic.

DEAR - EADR - RAED

SOME - OMSE - EMOS
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: The letters of the word are rearranged in a fixed cyclic pattern:

1st form → 2nd form → 3rd form (consistent rearrangement of positions)

For, DEAR → EADR → RAED

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2785b9c6f8bd538b6a67d26c1cc163e81839ebbca0714edc693839f861d68ab.png] 

For, SOME → OMSE → EMOS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59300a57f3dec4ecf2e4c015bce7452659b29ed0e310eab0651f11f0b899778c.png] 

Now, check the options:

Option 1) JUTE → UJTE → EUTJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce8c11f5d6dad32b70aaa7cd0c8dadcbe059501aa1034e618548570bf8ff8ba1.png] 

Option 2) ZONE → ZNOE → ENOZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99ec4529693bb9a83598be9773e493819f25777c28ce74f949694689891b9d50.png] 

Option 3) RACE → ACRE → ACER

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c7690c84c89fae1008f4bd763cf4f6c725334747f21d8101a79607c280e9784.png] 

Option 4) WARD → ARWD → DRAW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e75575f5cd4c2fd812c70ae9d6a68ca98b9f6ed0603df42970d1364c9aea0c20.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**
